Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

MEATBALL SUB BITES! Homemade meatballs tossed in pizza sauce, then wrapped up in pizza dough with mozzarella and baked until golden brown, then brushed with butter, parm & parsley. And warm pizza sauce for dipping. It’s game day season and these are the perfect 2-bite app that we’re 100% sure everyone will love!!  Full recipe at: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/meatball-sub-bites/ 1 lb 80/20 ground beef ½ cup Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs ½ cup whole milk 1 large egg ⅓ cup grated parmesan cheese 2 garlic cloves grated ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon black pepper 8 ounces pizza dough 12 ounces pizza sauce divided ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing Grated parmesan for topping Chopped parsley for topping Preheat your oven to 425˚F. To a small mixing bowl, add the breadcrumbs and milk together, stir, and let the mixture rest for five minutes. It should look like thick oatmeal, so add milk a tablespoon at a time if it looks dry. To a large mixing bowl, add the ground beef, panade, egg, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix gently by hand just until combined. Using a 3 tablespoon scoop, scoop into 14 meatballs and roll them into shape. Bake the meatballs 425°F for about 15 minutes. Slightly underbaked is fine; they'll be going back into the oven later. Toss the meatballs in about 4 ounces of the pizza sauce, setting the other half of the sauce aside for dipping later. They should be coated, not drenched. Cut the dough. Roll to ~12×10" and cut into squares. Grease a muffin tin. To make one of the meatball sub bites, add a square of pizza dough into one of the muffin slots, then place a pinch of shredded mozzarella on the bottom, a saucy meatball on top, and a pinch more mozzarella over it. Gather the corners over the top of the meatball, one at a time. Bake at 400°F for about 18-20 minutes, until deep golden and 160°F+ in the center. Brush with butter and parmesan before serving.

videos.caption: Crispy Honey Garlic Chicken Fried Rice🍗🍯🍚 One of the best sheet pan recipes, so simple and delicious - Minimal effort, a game changing way to meal prep for the week! Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 550 Calories | 42g Protein | 52g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Honey Garlic Chicken - 1300g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed and fat trimmed - 2.5 Tsp Black Pepper - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - 50g Honey - 30g Light Soy Sauce  - 25g Dark Soy Sauce Creamy Sriracha Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt  - 120g Light Mayo - 50g Sriracha - 25g Honey - 1.5 Tsp Smoked Paprika Toasted Sesame Fried Rice - 450-500g Frozen Mixed Vegetables (i had carrots, sweetcorn, green beans, peas) - 100g Green Onion, white part - 40g Sesame Seeds - 350-400g Uncooked White Rice (700-800g Cooked) - 40g Light Soy Sauce (adjust based on color) - 50g Green Onion, green part - 20g Light Butter, gives silky smooth texture to rice 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Slice chicken thighs into small cubes, trim excess fat, add seasoning with olive oil, honey and soy sauce. Mix well, set aside 2. In a bowl, add yogurt, mayo, sriracha, honey and smoked paprika. Mix till smooth. Bottle and refrigerate for the week 3. In a large lined sheet pan, spread marinated chicken, add cooking spray then oven bake for 20 mins at 190C / 390F until golden brown & crispy 4. Once chicken is cooked, remove from pan leaving resting juices. Add mixed veggies, green onion and sesame seeds. Mix thoroughly in all the chicken juices. Spread flat and oven roast for 15 mins 5. Once cooked, add leftover rice, soy sauce, green onion and light butter. Mix gently till coated and fluffy. Add chicken, mix well then serve with creamy sauce & ENJOY! . . . . #friedrice #honeygarlic #sheetpan #mealprep #healthyrecipes

✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

LOOK IDENTITY — AETHER NOMAD 9099 🛸🤎🤍🩶 📍 Date officielle de naissance du look : 22.08.9099 Un look imaginé pour une époque où la mode ne cherche plus à suivre le futur… elle vient directement de lui. Le pantalon cargo à double ceinture signé @flyerrer.official conserve l’ADN street des années 90/2000, mais ici, il est propulsé dans une autre dimension. Taille volontairement abaissée, volumes XXL, poches cargo, nuances beige poussière et chocolat : la silhouette semble avoir été retrouvée dans une archive venue de 9099. Cette fois, le haut change complètement l’histoire. La maille zippée à col montant et ses détails effet fourrure construisent une silhouette plus sculpturale, plus mystérieuse, presque extraterrestre. Sa palette claire dialogue parfaitement avec le pantalon et crée un contraste entre douceur, puissance et futurisme. Les deux ceintures deviennent une véritable signature visuelle. Les sneakers massives ancrent le look dans le présent, tandis que les lunettes futuristes et le chapeau que j’ai imaginé transportent l’ensemble bien au-delà de notre époque. 🕶️🛸 Et le plus important ? Je n’ai pas simplement assemblé des vêtements. J’ai construit une identité. La façon de porter chaque pièce, les proportions, les accessoires, les matières et l’attitude ont été pensés pour créer une silhouette que l’on remarque avant même de comprendre pourquoi. Aujourd’hui, les gens tournent la tête. Ils demandent des photos. Ils cherchent à comprendre. En 9099, ils chercheront probablement à comprendre d’où cette archive est arrivée. ⚡️ Conseil de style : Ne cherche pas à porter ce que tout le monde porte. Cherche à créer quelque chose que les autres n’ont encore jamais vu. La mode devient puissante lorsqu’elle ne demande pas : « Est-ce que ça plaît ? » Elle demande : « Est-ce que ça va rester dans leur mémoire ? » Un vrai look ne suit pas l’époque. Il lui donne quelque chose à rattraper. 🛸🤎🤍🩶🕶️ @flyerrer.official 🖤 @_startexceedend_ 🤍 #aethernomad9099

I’ve been seeing this chicken au poivre everywhere and wanted to try it.  Recipies below ⬇️ Bread Recipe: •4 cups bread flour (500g) •1½ cups + 1 tbsp warm water (375g) •2¼ tsp instant yeast (7g) @fleischmannsyeast  •1¾ tsp salt (10g) •2 tsp honey (10g) Mix water, honey, yeast, flour, and salt until just combined and sticky. Cover and rise 1½–2 hrs, doing 3–4 folds every 30 min. Divide into 3, shape, and proof 30–45 min. Score and bake at 475°F with steam for 10 min. Reduce to 450°F and bake 12–18 min until deeply golden. Cool 30 min before slicing. Chicken Au Poivre: •8 chicken thighs (bone-in + skin on)  seasonings: chicken soup blend, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, white pepper. •3 tbsp unsalted butter  •1 shallot  •3 garlic cloves  •1/4 cup light brandy  •1 cup chicken stock  •2 cups heavy whipping cream  •2 tbsp freshly ground black pepper  •1.5 tbsp fresh rosemary  •1 tbsp dijon mustard  •1 tbsp worcestershire sauce  •salt to taste  Sear chicken skin side down first for 25 minutes on low heat until golden, then flip and allow to cook another 10 minutes. Set chicken aside, add in butter, shallots and cook down for 1-2 minutes. Then add in garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Deglaze with brandy, and add in chicken stock, HWC, pepper, rosemary, Dijon, Worcestershire, and salt. Throw chicken + juices back in and allow to simmer on low for 25-30 mins.  Cheesy potato puree gratin: •8-10 medium Yukon gold potatoes  •1 stick of butter  •3 garlic cloves  •fresh rosemary + thyme  •2 cups milk  •white pepper  •grated nutmeg  •Parmesan cheese + mozzarella. Boil potatoes in heavily salted water until super tender. Melt butter in a sauce pan, cook garlic for 30 seconds, add in rosemary and thyme and cook for another 30 seconds, then add in milk, white pepper, and grated nutmeg, and salt to taste. Mix in riced potatoes with milk, and cheeses. Throw potatoes into a baking dish and broil until the top is golden.  Brussel sprouts seasoned with garlic butter herb seasoning + olive oil and baked at 450 for 20-25 mins .  Creme brûlée: •2 cups heavy cream  •1 vanilla bean (extract or paste work too) •6 egg yolks @Happy Egg  •1/2 cup sugar  •pinch of salt  Heat the heavy cream + vanilla bean until steaming. Whisk egg yolks, sugar, and salt. Slowly whisk in the hot cream to temper eggs then add in the rest. Pour into ramekins. Place in a water bath and bake at 325°F until set with a slight jiggle (40-60 mins varying by oven). Cool and refrigerate. Sprinkle sugar on top and torch until golden and crisp.  #chickenaupoivre #mashedpotatoes #cheesypotatopureegratin #homemadebread #cremebrulee

🚨 Better Than KFC Chicken Strips (No Debate) 👀🍗 Crispy. Juicy. Dangerous. Once you make these, takeaway is gonna feel like a scam. 🛒 Ingredients Chicken * 1kg chicken breast, cut into strips 💦 Wet Batter * 300g plain flour * 1 tbsp salt * 1 tsp baking powder * 1 tbsp chilli powder * 1 tsp garlic powder * 2 eggs * 300ml water * 100ml pickle juice (the secret ingredient… trust the process 😮‍💨) ✨ Dry Coating * 450g plain flour * 30g cornflour * 1 tbsp salt * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp chilli powder 👨‍🍳 Method 1. Whisk together all the wet batter ingredients until smooth. 2. Toss in the chicken strips so they’re fully coated. Cover and let them marinate for at least 4 hours (overnight if you’ve got the patience). 3. Mix all the dry coating ingredients in a separate bowl. 4. Heat your oil to 170°C. 5. Take each chicken strip out of the wet batter and coat it in the dry mix. Don’t be shy—PRESS that coating on. That’s how you get those crispy, craggy bits that hit every time. 6. Fry until golden and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 75°C. 7. Let them rest for a minute, then serve with your favourite dipping sauce. 💯 Pro Tip The pickle juice doesn’t make the chicken taste like pickles—it just makes it ridiculously juicy and tender. It’s low-key carrying the whole recipe. #friedchicken #fyp #foodtok #easy #yummy

Cheesy Broccoli, Chicken, and Rice Skillet is super easy to make and can be on the table in 30 minutes!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast 2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, and paprika  1 tbsp ranch seasoning  1 tbsp minced garlic 2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed  2 cups chopped broccoli  1 1/2 cups shredded Colby Jack cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken into small pieces. Roughly chop broccoli into smaller pieces (just be careful not to chop too small or it will completely fall apart while cooking).  Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and onions and spread them out evenly in pan. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, and ranch seasoning.  Once chicken is almost cooked through add minced garlic. Add the rinsed rice, broccoli, and chicken broth. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover with a lid.  Let cook covered for about 18 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add about a cup of shredded cheddar cheese and stir. Top with more cheese and cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes. Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out! #easyrecipes #dinner #mealideas

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Crack Chicken Bake 🐔🧀🥓🍲🔥 RECIPE ⬇️ Ingredients: Chicken Breast Cream Cheese Sour Cream Jalapeños  Bacon Colby Jack Cheese Seasonings: Paprika Seasoned Salt Black Pepper Garlic Powder Ranch Seasoning Onion Powder Instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Cut your chicken into bite-sized pieces and add them to a 7x11 baking dish. Season the chicken with onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, seasoned salt, and paprika. Mix well to ensure everything is evenly coated. In a separate bowl, add one block of softened cream cheese and season with garlic powder and pepper. Marinate the Chicken Add chicken thighs to a large bowl. Coat fully with spicy brown mustard. Season generously with Cuso’s Hot Honey + Roasted Garlic & Onion seasoning. Mix until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight preferred). 2. Preheat the Grill Preheat your pellet grill to 350°F. Load with Harmos pellets (Spanish Barbecue Pirate + Turkish Barbecue Traveler) for deep smoky flavor with paprika, garlic, rosemary, and spice notes. 3. Make the Jalapeño Green Sauce Add jalapeños, cilantro, garlic, Greek yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning or heat. Chill until ready to serve. 4. Smoke the Chicken Place chicken directly on the grill grates. Cook for about 1 hour, until internal temp reaches 160°F. 5. Crank the Heat Increase grill temp to 500°F. Cook until chicken hits 180°F internal and skin gets crispy with great color. 6. Serve Remove from grill and rest a few minutes. Serve with the jalapeño green sauce on the side or drizzled over top. #HarmosGrill  #HarmosWoodPellets  #HarmosFlavoredPellets

During the final 30 minutes, add broccoli in (optional) 6. Serve the chicken over steamed rice, spoon that teriyaki sauce over everything and finish with green onions and optional sesame seeds. 🤤 It’s flavorful, family-friendly and ridiculously easy. Chicken Au Poivre‼️ Full Video Things you need  Whole chicken Sherry Wine (Holland House Cooking Wine) 1 Large Shallot Minced Garlic (3-4 cloves) Heavy Whipping Cream, 2 - 2.5 cups Fresh Cracked Black Pepper Fresh Rosemary, chopped    Chicken Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Chili Powder, Paprika, Kinder’s Buttery Poultry Seasoning, Dried Parlsey  Sauce Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder Directions  1. Prepare the Chicken Clean the chicken using 1 part vinegar to 2 parts water. Remove the insides, then butterfly the chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen shears. Lay the chicken meat‑side up, pat dry, and press down firmly to flatten. Season generously with the listed seasonings, including salt and cracked black pepper on the underside. 2. Cook the Chicken Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium‑high. Once hot, sear the whole chicken skin‑side down until browned, about 4–5 minutes per side. If cooking multiple chickens, repeat the process. Transfer the browned chicken(s) to a baking dish. Add about 1/3 cup water to the bottom of the dish, cover, and place in the oven while you prepare the sauce 3. Prepare the Sauce In the same skillet used for searing, add diced shallots, garlic, and chopped rosemary. Cook for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken. Deglaze with 1/2 cup Sherry cooking wine and cook for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 – 2.5 cups heavy whipping cream, whisking to combine. Season with the listed sauce seasonings and cook for 3–4 minutes, whisking occasionally. 4. Finish the Dish Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream sauce over the top. Return to the oven and cook for 60–90 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. Baste the chicken with the cream sauce every 30 minutes, stirring the sauce before each baste. For reference: a 3–4 lb chicken typically cooks in about 1 hour and 20 minutes. 5. Serve Serve the chicken over mashed potatoes or rice, and garnish with parsley. #cookingvideos #chickenaupoivre #recipes #fyp #mashedpotatoes

Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

videos.caption: Takeout-Style Chicken Onion Stir-Fry Ingredients: Chicken breast, thinly sliced 1 onion, sliced into strips Spring onion, cut into sections Ginger slices Minced garlic Oil for cooking A pinch of salt ½ cup water Marinade: 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tsp dark soy sauce ½ tbsp oyster sauce 1 tbsp cooking wine 1 tsp baking soda 1 tsp sugar 1 tsp chicken powder Black pepper 1 tbsp corn starch ½ tbsp sesame oil Steps: 1 Slice the chicken breast thinly. 2 Add soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, cooking wine, baking soda, sugar, chicken powder, black pepper, corn starch, and sesame oil. Mix well and marinate for 15 minutes. 3 Slice the onion into strips. Cut the spring onion into sections, keeping the white and green parts separate. 4 Heat a little oil in a pan. Add the onion with a pinch of salt and stir-fry for 1 minute. Remove and set aside. 5 Add a little more oil if needed. Add ginger slices, minced garlic, chicken, and the white part of the spring onion. 6 Spread the chicken out and let it sear, then flip and stir-fry until cooked. 7 Add about ½ cup water. The corn starch from the chicken will loosen into the sauce and make it thick and glossy, so you don’t need extra corn starch slurry. 8 Add the green part of the spring onion and the cooked onion back in. Toss everything together and serve with rice. #ChickenStirFry #TakeoutStyle #EasyDinner #ChineseCooking #RiceBowl

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

✨ Did you know you can make DIY taste-safe kinetic sand with simple ingredients from your pantry? It's non-toxic, budget-friendly, and perfect for toddlers! My 3-year-old often stays busy for an hour playing with it—molding shapes, digging treasures, and pretending to bake "cakes."  Ingredients You’ll Need: 1 cup baking soda 1/2 cup cornstarch 1/2 cup sugar 2–4 tablespoons warm water  (mix with food coloring of your choice) 1 tablespoon cream of tartar Step-by-Step Instructions: Mix the dry ingredients In a large mixing bowl, combine the baking soda, cornstarch, sugar, and cream of tartar. Stir until evenly distributed. Prepare the colored water In a small bowl, add a few drops of food coloring to the warm water. Adjust the intensity of the color by adding more or fewer drops. Combine wet and dry ingredients Gradually add the colored water to the dry mixture, 1 tablespoon at a time. Mix with a spoon or your hands until the sand reaches your desired consistency—moist and moldable, but not sticky. You may not need all the water, so add it slowly! Test and play Once the mixture holds its shape when squeezed, it’s ready for playtime! If it feels too dry, add a few drops of water. If it’s too sticky, sprinkle in a bit more cornstarch. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

One-Pan Chicken & Rice aka Arroz con Pollo 🥘 @HexClad @Goya Foods @Kerrygold USA @getgraza  Ingredients * 2–3 lbs chicken thighs * 2 cups rice * 4 cups chicken broth or water * 1 red bell pepper, diced * ½ medium onion, diced * ½ cup carrots, diced * 4 garlic cloves, minced * 2–3 tbsp butter * Olive oil * 1-2 tbsp chicken bouillon * Salt, to taste * Fresh cilantro, for garnish * Paprika * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Goya Adobo seasoning Instructions 1. Dice the red bell pepper, onion, and carrots, and mince the garlic. 2. Season both sides of the chicken thighs with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and Goya Adobo. 3. Heat a little olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Sear the chicken thighs for about 4 minutes per side, or until they develop a beautiful golden crust. Remove the chicken and set aside. 4. In the same pan, add the bell pepper, onion, carrots, and garlic. Add 2–3 tablespoons of butter and sauté for a few minutes, until fragrant. 5. Add 2 cups of rice and sauté it with the vegetables for another 1–2 minutes. 6. Pour in 4 cups of chicken broth (or water) and stir in chicken bouillon. Taste the liquid and add salt or more chicken bouillon if needed. 7. Nestle the chicken thighs back on top of the rice. Pour in any juices that collected on the plate—don’t waste that flavor! 8. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for about 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken is fully cooked (165°F internally). 9. Turn off the heat and leave the pan covered for another 5–10 minutes before serving. 10. Finish with fresh cilantro and serve. #chickenandrice #EasyRecipe #mealprep #arrozconpollo #DinnerIdeas

Tristan Harris says one of the biggest AI risks is already showing up. Not in theory. In documented incidents. First: an Alibaba AI model during training. It began using tools it had access to. Created a hidden channel outside the company's firewall. Repurposed GPUs to mine cryptocurrency. Without being told to do any of it. Then came the OpenAI incident. July. OpenAI models bypassed controls meant to keep them off the internet. Used unauthorized channels to communicate. Exploited weak points in shared systems. Reached Hugging Face infrastructure during internal cyber tests. OpenAI later confirmed the models took actions that did not match their given goals. That disclosure is what makes Harris's warning hard to dismiss. His argument is about mechanism, not malice. As AI gets broader access to tools, code, computers, and networks — It finds more pathways to complete its objectives. Including pathways nobody designed or anticipated. The Alibaba model was not trying to undermine the company. It found a route and used it. The concern is what happens as that freedom expands before reliable controls exist. Both incidents happened. Both were disclosed. Neither is theoretical. Send this to someone who thinks AI safety concerns are overblown. #TristanHarris #AISafety #OpenAI #AILadder

Huli Huli Chicken | Recipes Jordan Should Know Ep. 10 #cooking #recipe Recipe Huli Huli Chicken Ingredients * 5 chicken leg quarters * 2/3 cup soy sauce * 2/3 cup pineapple juice * 1/2 cup brown sugar * 1/3 cup ketchup * 3 tbsp rice vinegar * 1 tbsp sesame oil * 1 1/2 tbsp grated ginger * 5 garlic cloves, minced * 1/4 cup chopped onion * 1 tsp black pepper Directions 1. Mix all marinade ingredients in a bowl. 2. Save 1 cup of marinade for basting later. 3. Pour the rest over the chicken. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. 4. Heat grill to about 400°F. 5. Grill chicken skin-side up for 30 minutes with the lid closed. 6. Simmer the saved marinade for 5–8 minutes to make a glaze. 7. Flip the chicken and brush with glaze. 8. Keep flipping and basting every 10 minutes until cooked through. 9. Chicken is done when the thickest part reaches at least 175°F. 10. Serve with rice and Hawaiian mac salad.

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. How to build an AI employee that works while you sleep. An AI agent is just a loop (goal → step → check → repeat) that can reach for tools. On its own it hits a wall: it forgets everything, waits for you, owns nothing. The ladder that turns it into staff: • ① context — files YOU write; it reads them every run so nothing's generic, and they grow (you're raising it) • ② memory — facts + your rules + how-to's; a skill is a memory • ③ a lane, not a task • ④ tools — MCP, ~1 min to connect • ⑤ a schedule — wakes on its own, pings you only for decisions • ⑥ guardrails — low-stakes it does; high-stakes it drafts and waits for your yes I run mine from a Google Sheet — it drafts every reply in my voice, I approve in 10 minutes, every 30 minutes it sends the approved ones and learns from my revisions. The moat: anyone can buy the same AI. Nobody has your context. Come build it with me. #aiemployee #aiagent #aiautomation #professorglitch

👀🍫FUDGY BROWNIE CHEESECAKE BARS…  No baking required. Makes 7 BIG bars, each with: 240 cals, 10g protein, 10 net carbs Here is another viral recipe that absolutely holds up to the hype. You’ve got a rich brownie base, a creamy cheesecake center, and a chocolate layer right on top. These are a little more dense than your traditional brownie cheesecake bar, but made with better-for-you ingredients, incredibly satisfying, and SO GOOD. Big thanks to @nora.dora99 for this amazing recipe! Here’s how to make them: FOR THE BROWNIE BASE: 150g almond flour 30g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 3 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Splash of vanilla extract Mix everything together until you have a brownie batter. Press it firmly into a parchment-lined loaf pan or small baking dish and freeze for 10 mins. FOR THE CHEESECAKE LAYER: 250g fat-free cream cheese (regular works too!) 10g sweetener of choice Splash of vanilla extract Squeeze of lemon juice I processed this in a food processor, but you can also use a hand mixer. Then spread it over the brownie base and freeze for about 45 mins. FOR THE CHOCOLATE TOPPING: 40g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 2 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Mix until smooth, spread it over the cheesecake layer, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set. I cut these into 7 bars, but you can cut them into whatever size bars you like to manage your own goals. videos.caption: XPeng’s humanoid robot IRON went viral after it fell during its first offline public demo at MixC Shenzhen Bay in Shenzhen on January 31, 2026. In videos from the event, IRON walks out with an eerily smooth, humanlike “model stride,” pauses near the center, and then—while raising an arm to the crowd—loses balance and faceplants. Staff reach in to steady it, but the robot still goes down and then has to be moved offstage by multiple people, which underlined just how heavy and non-human it really is.  The moment hit extra hard because IRON already had an “uncanny” reputation: XPeng has showcased it as a highly lifelike humanoid (even doing dramatic proof-of-it’s-not-a-person stunts during earlier reveals), and online skeptics had questioned whether the gait clips were real robotics.  XPeng’s CEO He Xiaopeng framed the fall as a normal development milestone—like a toddler learning to walk before it can run—and coverage noted subsequent demos using more support, hinting balance robustness is still a work in progress.

I realized I never gave ya’ll the recipe to my BigBrownieChunks or bbc recipe so…here ya go! So gooey!  🍫Pan: 8×8-inch light metal pan Oven: 350°F Ingredients: * 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter * 1⅓ cups (120 g) Dutch-processed cocoa powder * 1 teaspoon fine sea salt * 2½ cups powdered sugar * ½ cup light brown sugar * 3 large eggs, room temperature * 1 additional egg yolk, room temperature * 3 teaspoons vanilla extract * 1 cup (120 g) all-purpose flour * 1½ cups (280 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips * ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar * Powdered sugar, for finishing Step-by-Step 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line an 8×8-inch light metal pan with parchment paper. 2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Continue cooking, stirring frequently, until it becomes golden brown, smells nutty, and you can see browned milk solids at the bottom. 3. Add the cocoa powder and salt to a heat safe bowl. Immediately pour the hot browned butter over the cocoa and whisk or stir until completely smooth and glossy. Let cool until warm, not hot. 4. Whisk the sugars & eggs for that crackle top! In a separate large bowl, combine the powdered sugar, brown sugar, 3 eggs, and additional egg yolk. Whisk HARD for 60–90 seconds, until the mixture looks lighter, thick, glossy, and well combined. 5. Stir the vanilla into the warm cocoa butter mixture. Pour the cocoa mixture into the egg & sugar mixture and whisk until the batter is thick, dark, smooth, and shiny. 6. Gently fold in the flour just until the last dry streak disappears. Do not overmix. 7. Reserve 1/4 cup of batter for extra crackle top! set it aside. 8. Gently fold 1½ cups semi-sweet chocolate chips into the remaining batter. Spread the chocolate-chip brownie batter evenly into the prepared pan. 9. Make the smooth crackle layer Take the reserved ¼ cup of chip-free batter and spread it very thinly over the surface. 10. Sprinkle the ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar over the top. These will melt into gooey chocolate pockets. 11. Bake at 350°F for 28–35 minutes. Don’t wait for a completely clean toothpick! the brownies are supposed to stay molten and fudgy inside. 12. Let the brownies cool completely in the pan before lifting them out. #brownies #brownierecipe #molten #chocolate
